title: Add or Remove a Robot in the Geek Plus RMS Robot Selection Web View
summary: Use the Geek Plus RMS Robot Selection web view to add a robot by robot ID or remove an existing robot, and confirm success messages after each action.
when_to_use: When you need to manage the Geek Plus RMS robot roster using the Robot Selection Add/Remove workflow and verify the on-screen success confirmations.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Robot Selection Add/Remove actions in the Geek Plus RMS web UI and verify the corresponding success confirmation messages.
access_or_tools_needed: Geek Plus RMS web application access via an OT network device (local) or authorized remote access
Authorized remote authorization via UPS VPN through Zscaler (if not on OT network)

access_required: Access to the Geek Plus RMS web application (RMS / fleet status UI)
system_preconditions: You can reach the site/RMS address from your authorized network path (OT network locally, or UPS VPN through Zscaler for remote support).

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Add and Remove web view showing Robot ID entry, Add button, Remove section, and success confirmation messaging.

steps.title: Open Geek Plus RMS web application from an authorized network path
steps.purpose: Ensure you can access the Geek Plus RMS Robot Selection web view to perform add/remove actions.
steps.instruction: From an OT network device, open the Geek Plus RMS web application using the site/RMS address. If you are supporting remotely, ensure you are authorized to use the UPS VPN through Zscaler and can reach the site/RMS address.
steps.expected_result: The Geek Plus RMS web application loads successfully and you can navigate to the Robot Selection screen.
steps.healthy_condition: You can access the Geek Plus RMS web application from your current network authorization path.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot access the Geek Plus RMS web application (no reachable site/RMS address).

actions.label: Verify authorized access path
actions.exact_action: Ensure you are authorized to use the UPS VPN through Zscaler (for remote support) and can reach the site/RMS address.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Geek Plus RMS web application, stop and escalate for support (the source does not provide remediation steps beyond access dependency).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Any device connected on the OT network ... will have access to the web software application right through that IP. If you're supporting remotely, we will not have access to OT net unless you're authorized to use the UPS VPN which is through Z Scaler... Once you have that, you will be able to put in the address or RMS address for that particular site and access the Geek plus RMS.

steps.title: Navigate to the Robot Selection screen with Add Robot and Remove Robot controls
steps.purpose: Reach the specific Robot Selection UI where robot IDs can be entered and Add/Remove actions can be executed.
steps.instruction: In the Geek Plus RMS web application, navigate to the Robot Selection screen that contains the Robot ID entry field and the Add Robot and Remove Robot controls.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection screen is visible with the Robot ID entry field and the Add and Remove controls.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Robot ID entry area and the Add/Remove controls on the Robot Selection screen.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the Robot Selection screen or the Add/Remove controls are not visible.

actions.label: Confirm Robot Selection screen elements
actions.exact_action: Confirm the Robot Selection screen shows the Robot field/entry area and the Add Robot and Remove Robot controls.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Robot Selection Add and Remove: enter robot ID, click "Add" and verify "adding was successful"; for removal enter/select robot, click "Remove" and verify "removal was successful".

steps.title: Add a robot by robot ID
steps.purpose: Add the specified robot to the Geek Plus RMS system using the Robot Selection Add workflow.
steps.instruction: In the Robot ID entry field, enter the corresponding robot ID. (If the robot is already introduced, partial numeric entry may surface matching robots.) Click the "Add" button.
steps.expected_result: A confirmation message appears indicating the robot was added successfully ("adding was successful" / "robot was added successfully").
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows the success confirmation for the Add action after clicking "Add".
steps.failure_condition: No "adding was successful" confirmation message appears after clicking "Add".

actions.label: Enter Robot ID
actions.exact_action: Type the robot ID into the field below Robot.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the success confirmation does not appear after clicking "Add", stop and escalate for support (the source does not provide troubleshooting steps for failures).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To add a robot: type it into the right below robot... If it's already been introduced, you can just do 188... then they'll show... ones ending in 188... Click "Add"... The system will show that the adding was successful.
OCR: "Robot Selection Add and Remove" ... "Enter the corresponding robot ID" ... "Click \"Add\"" ... "The system will show that the adding was successful".

steps.title: Remove a robot by robot ID or by selecting it from the list
steps.purpose: Remove the specified robot from the Geek Plus RMS system using the Robot Selection Remove workflow.
steps.instruction: Enter the corresponding robot ID in the Robot ID entry field or select the robot from the list shown for that ID. Click the "Remove" button.
steps.expected_result: A confirmation message appears indicating the robot was removed successfully ("removal was successful" / "remove what was successful").
steps.healthy_condition: The UI shows the success confirmation for the Remove action after clicking "Remove".
steps.failure_condition: No "removal was successful" confirmation message appears after clicking "Remove".

actions.label: Enter Robot ID or select robot
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot from the list shown for that ID.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the success confirmation does not appear after clicking "Remove", stop and escalate for support (the source does not provide troubleshooting steps for failures).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: To remove a robot: enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot from the list shown for that ID. Click "Remove"... The system will show that the removal was successful.
OCR: "Remove Robot" ... "Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot" ... "Click \"Remove\"" ... "The system will show that the removal was successful".

success_criteria: After clicking "Add", the Robot Selection screen displays an "adding was successful" confirmation message.
After clicking "Remove", the Robot Selection screen displays a "removal was successful" confirmation message.
healthy_conditions: Robot Selection screen shows the expected success confirmation text/state after Add/Remove actions.
failure_conditions: No success confirmation appears after clicking "Add".
No success confirmation appears after clicking "Remove".
escalation_guidance: If the success confirmation does not appear after clicking "Add" or "Remove", stop and escalate for support (the source does not provide troubleshooting steps for failures).

screens_or_images.description: Robot Selection Add and Remove UI with Robot ID entry, Add/Remove controls, and success confirmation messaging.
